descriptionByLocale.it:
Per accordo
Il 4 stelle-plus Resort Hof Weissbad gode di un'ottima reputazione come azienda innovativa e di successo. Dobbiamo il nostro successo ai nostri circa 270 dipendenti amichevoli e motivati.
Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Si lavora indipendentemente in una cucina varia e non-routine (16 punti Gault Millau)

• Si creano piatti contemporanei, creativi e di alta qualità

• Si assiste a garantire fluidi flussi di lavoro

• Aiutate con la formazione degli apprendisti

• Aderisci alle linee guida di qualità e igiene e effettui controlli di qualità delle merci
Cosa ci aspettiamo da te

• Hai la formazione come cuoco / chef EFZ

• Hai già acquisito esperienza professionale nella gastronomia di lusso in una posizione simile

• Possiedi un'esperienza eccellente nel tuo campo

• Sei un talento organizzativo

• Sei flessibile e può essere utilizzato in tutte le stazioni della cucina

• Il vostro impegno e flessibilità vi contraddistinguono

• Sei creativo e hai standard di alta qualità e igiene
Cosa ti offriamo

• Catering: la nostra cucina evoca anche pasti freschi, sani e sovvenzionati per i nostri dipendenti

• Salute: per rimanere in forma e sano, i nostri dipendenti utilizzano la zona di balneazione e fitness gratuitamente

• Sostegno: promuoviamo il vostro sviluppo professionale attraverso un contributo ai costi di ulteriore formazione

• Sconti: si beneficiano di sconti nel nostro hotel, nella regione e con le società partner del gruppo ERFA e gli Hotel di Selezione Privata

• Altre prestazioni : assegni per il fine settimana e parcheggio gratuito
Vi offriamo una posizione interessante in un hotel straordinario. Si beneficiano di condizioni di lavoro progressivo e generosi vantaggi frangia dipendenti. Maggiori informazioni su di noi su www.hofweissbad.ch.
descriptionByLocale.en:
By arrangement
The 4-star-plus Resort Hof Weissbad enjoys an excellent reputation as an innovative and successful company. We owe our success to our approximately 270 friendly and motivated employees.
These are your tasks

• You work independently in a varied, non-routine kitchen (16 Gault Millau points)

• You create contemporary, creative and high-quality dishes

• You assist in ensuring smooth workflows

• You help with the training of apprentices

• You adhere to quality and hygiene guidelines and carry out quality checks of goods
What we expect from you

• You have training as a cook / chef EFZ

• You have already gained professional experience in upscale gastronomy in a similar position

• You possess excellent expertise in your field

• You are an organisational talent

• You are flexible and can be deployed in all kitchen stations

• Your commitment and flexibility distinguish you

• You are creative and have high quality and hygiene standards
What we offer you

• Catering : our kitchen also conjures up fresh, healthy and subsidised meals for our employees

• Health : to stay fit and healthy, our employees use the bathing and fitness area free of charge

• Support : we promote your professional development through a contribution to the costs of further training

• Discounts : you benefit from discounts in our hotel, in the region as well as with partner companies of the ERFA group and the Private Selection Hotels

• Further benefits : weekend allowances and free parking
We offer you an interesting position in an extraordinary hotel. You benefit from progressive working conditions and generous employee fringe benefits. More about us at www.hofweissbad.ch.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Receptionist (m/f/d | 60 - 100 %)
By arrangement
We are looking for people with passion. For their profession, for the team and our guests. As an innovative and successful company, we offer attractive employment conditions in one of the most beautiful resorts in Eastern Switzerland. We owe our success to our approximately 270 friendly and motivated employees with great team spirit.
These are your tasks

• You are the warm and courteous contact person at the reception – check-ins and check-outs

• You take care of guest services on site – information, advice, sales

• You handle all enquiries by phone, email or in person – receiving and processing reservations, interface to other departments

• You perform additional tasks – vouchers, kiosk, table reservations, general administrative work
What we expect from you

• You have training in the hotel or tourism sector or comparable professional experience at a 4* hotel reception

• You love guest contact, are communicative and always remain charming

• You have a strong service awareness and are always ready to go the extra mile for our guests

• You know the region or are willing to acquire this knowledge independently

• You are reliable, extremely conscientious and enjoy working independently as well as in a team

• You speak German and English – additional languages are a plus

• You are IT-savvy and familiar with common hotel systems (Opera Cloud, Aleno, common Office programmes)
What we offer you

• Family-friendly : we offer you 5 weeks’ holiday, the possibility of part-time work

• Catering : our kitchen also conjures up fresh, healthy and subsidised meals for our employees

• Health : to stay fit and healthy, our employees use the bathing and fitness area free of charge

• Support : we promote your professional development through a contribution to further training costs

• Discounts : you benefit from discounts in our hotel, in the region as well as with partner companies of the ERFA group and the Private Selection Hotels

• Additional benefits : weekend allowances and free parking

descriptionByLocale.en:
From June 1, 2026 or by arrangement
The 4-star-plus Resort Hof Weissbad enjoys an excellent reputation as an innovative and successful company. In one of the most beautiful resorts in Eastern Switzerland, you will find not only a warm team spirit but also attractive employment conditions. We owe our success to our approximately 270 friendly and motivated employees.
These are your tasks

• Independent care, support, and accompaniment of inpatient patients

• Professional execution of nursing measures within your own area of competence

• Responsible implementation of daily personal care and support of patients in daily life activities

• Recognizing changes and emergency situations, acting appropriately, and initiating necessary measures

• Taking over administrative and organizational tasks in everyday nursing
What we expect from you

• Completed training as a Health Specialist EFZ or equivalent foreign training with SRK recognition or positive PreCheck

• Professional, empathetic demeanor, neat appearance, and very good manners

• Enjoyment in working with people and strong service orientation

• Internalized professional standards regarding hygiene, cleanliness, and structured work

• Team player and communicative personality

• Good observation skills, quick understanding of situations, and responsible actions

• Resilience and calmness even in demanding or hectic situations

• Willingness to work weekend shifts and flexible deployment for holiday cover
What we offer you

• Catering : our kitchen also conjures up fresh, healthy, and subsidized meals for our employees

• Health : to stay fit and healthy, our employees use the bathing and fitness area free of charge

• Promotion : we support your professional development through cost-sharing for further training

• Discounts : you benefit from discounts in our hotel, in the region, as well as with partner companies of the ERFA group and the Private Selection Hotels

• Additional benefits : weekend bonuses and free parking
